ko.title: "선거가 치러질 것이다": 델시 로드리게스의 첫 유엔 연설이 보여주는 마두로 이후 베네수엘라의 행보

segments.src: Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, took the podium at the United Nations General Assembly on September 23, 2026, and told world leaders that "elections will be held in Venezuela."
segments.tr: 베네수엘라의 델시 로드리게스 임시 대통령은 2026년 9월 23일 유엔총회 연단에 올라 세계 지도자들에게 "베네수엘라에서 선거가 치러질 것"이라고 밝혔다.

segments.src: What she did not say was when.
segments.tr: 그녀가 말하지 않은 것은 시기였다.

segments.src: Nearly nine months after U.S.
segments.tr: 미국이 니콜라스 마두로를 체포한 지 약 9개월 만에 이루어진

segments.src: forces captured Nicolás Maduro in January, the speech offered a promise, a tone of reconciliation with Washington, and very few specifics.
segments.tr: 1월의 이 연설은 약속과 워싱턴과의 화해 기조를 담고 있었으나, 구체적인 내용은 거의 없었다.

segments.src: This explainer covers what she said, what was missing, and how the United States and Venezuela's opposition may respond, based on reporting from NBC News, NPR, UPI and analysis from the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS).
segments.tr: 이 해설 기사는 NBC News, NPR, UPI의 보도와 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)의 분석을 바탕으로 그녀가 한 말, 빠진 내용, 그리고 미국과 베네수엘라 야권이 어떻게 반응할지에 대해 다룬다.

segments.src: ## Why this speech matters
segments.tr: ## 이 연설이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Rodríguez's appearance carried symbolic weight before she said a word.
segments.tr: 로드리게스의 등장은 그녀가 한마디도 하기 전부터 상징적 무게감을 지녔다.

segments.src: Reports describe it as the first visit to the United States by a Venezuelan head of state since 2018, when Maduro himself traveled to New York for the General Assembly.
segments.tr: 마두로 본인이 총회 참석차 뉴욕을 방문했던 2018년 이후 베네수엘라 국가원수로서 미국을 방문한 것은 이번이 처음이라고 보도된다.

segments.src: She took over after a surprise U.S.
segments.tr: 그녀는 마두로를 체포해 마약 밀매 혐의로 미국으로 압송한 미국의 깜짝

segments.src: military operation in January that captured Maduro and brought him to the United States to face drug trafficking charges.
segments.tr: 군사 작전이 1월에 단행된 이후 권력을 이어받았다.

segments.src: Since then, her government and Washington have moved from confrontation toward a working, if uneasy, relationship.
segments.tr: 그 이후로 그녀의 정부와 워싱턴은 대립에서 벗어나 불안정하지만 실무적인 관계(working, if uneasy, relationship)로 전환했다.

segments.src: Standing at the UN lectern, Rodríguez was presenting Venezuela's new chapter to the world for the first time.
segments.tr: 유엔 연단에 선 로드리게스는 세계를 향해 베네수엘라의 새로운 장을 처음으로 선보이고 있었다.

segments.src: ## What she said
segments.tr: ## 그녀가 한 말

segments.src: According to news reports, the main points of the address were:
segments.tr: 뉴스 보도에 따르면 이번 연설의 주요 내용은 다음과 같다.

segments.src: - **A pledge of elections.** "Elections will be held in Venezuela," she said, adding that the Venezuelan people will determine the "right moment" to move the process forward.
segments.tr: - **선거 다짐.** 그녀는 "베네수엘라에서 선거가 치러질 것"이라고 말하며, 프로세스를 진전시킬 "올바른 시기"는 베네수엘라 국민이 결정할 것이라고 덧붙였다.

segments.src: - **A dialogue with the opposition.** She said her government has begun a "political dialogue with opposition sectors" aimed at a process "based on equal conditions for all."
segments.tr: - **야권과의 대화.** 그녀는 정부가 "모두를 위한 평등한 조건에 기반한" 프로세스를 목표로 "야권 부문과의 정치적 대화"를 시작했다고 밝혔다.

segments.src: - **Institutional readiness.** When a vote does take place, she said, the country's institutions "will be prepared to guarantee an inclusive and transparent process."
segments.tr: - **제도적 준비 태세.** 투표가 실제로 치러질 때, 국가의 기관들이 "포용적이고 투명한 프로세스를 보장할 준비가 되어 있을 것"이라고 그녀는 말했다.

segments.src: - **A definition of democracy.** "Democracy is not measured by the mere existence of elections," she argued. It is measured, in her words, by the quality of the competition that comes before them.
segments.tr: - **민주주의의 정의.** "민주주의는 단순히 선거의 존재 여부로 평가되지 않는다"고 그녀는 주장했다. 민주주의는 그에 앞서 이루어지는 경쟁의 질로 평가된다는 것이다.

segments.src: - **A message of renewal.** "Today, Venezuela is being reborn," she said, while cautioning, "I do not promise you an easy way forward." She described rebuilding the country's "national soul" as a priority.
segments.tr: - **갱생의 메시지.** 그녀는 "오늘, 베네수엘라는 다시 태어나고 있다"고 말하면서도, "순탄한 앞날을 약속하지는 않겠다"고 경고했다. 그녀는 베네수엘라의 "민족적 영혼"을 재건하는 것을 우선순위로 꼽았다.

segments.src: - **Thanks to Washington.** She thanked President Donald Trump and his administration for their willingness to restore diplomatic ties and described a recent meeting as "historic." She named energy, economic cooperation, security and the fight against transnational crime as areas of shared interest, and called a recent oil agreement one of the largest ever reached between the two countries.
segments.tr: - **워싱턴에 대한 감사.** 그녀는 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 그의 행정부가 외교 관계 복원에 보여준 의지에 감사를 표하고 최근의 만남을 "역사적"이라고 묘사했다. 그녀는 에너지, 경제 협력, 안보, 초국가적 범죄 대응을 공동 관심 분야로 꼽았으며, 최근의 석유 협정을 양국 간에 체결된 사상 최대 규모 중 하나로 불렀다.

segments.src: ## What she left out
segments.tr: ## 그녀가 언급하지 않은 것

segments.src: Several observers noted the gaps as much as the promises.
segments.tr: 여러 관찰자들은 약속만큼이나 그 빈틈에도 주목했다.

segments.src: - **No date.** The most important detail for any election, the calendar, was absent. She offered no timeline and no benchmarks for setting one.
segments.tr: - **날짜 부재.** 모든 선거에서 가장 중요한 세부 사항인 일정이 빠져 있었다. 그녀는 어떤 타임라인도, 일정을 설정하기 위한 기준점도 제시하지 않았다.

segments.src: - **No named negotiating partners.** She referred to "opposition sectors" without identifying which groups are at the table.
segments.tr: - **대화 상대방 미지정.** 그녀는 어떤 그룹이 협상 테이블에 나와 있는지 밝히지 않은 채 "야권 부문"이라고만 언급했다.

segments.src: - **No detail on judicial or electoral reform.** Independent analysts point out that credible elections usually depend on an updated voter roll and a restructured electoral authority. CSIS reports that no restructuring of the National Electoral Council has been discussed, and that voter rolls remain outdated.
segments.tr: - **사법 및 선거 개혁에 대한 세부 사항 부재.** 독립 분석가들은 신뢰할 수 있는 선거는 대개 업데이트된 유권자 명부와 개편된 선거 당국에 달려 있다고 지적한다. CSIS는 국가선거위원회(National Electoral Council)의 개편에 대해 논의된 바 없으며 유권자 명부가 여전히 구식이라고 보도했다.

segments.src: - **No direct response to the UN's own findings.** A UN fact-finding mission recently reported that Venezuela's repressive apparatus "remains entirely intact," and that rights violations continue despite improvements. Rodríguez's speech did not directly address that assessment.
segments.tr: - **유엔 자체 조사 결과에 대한 직접적인 반응 부재.** 유엔 진상조사단은 최근 베네수엘라의 억압 기구가 "완전히 온전하게 남아 있으며", 개선에도 불구하고 인권 침해가 지속되고 있다고 보고했다. 로드리게스의 연설은 이러한 평0가에 대해 직접적으로 다루지 않았다.

segments.src: - **No mention of Maduro by name,** according to NBC News, a notable omission given that his capture is what brought her to office.
segments.tr: - **마두로를 이름으로 언급하지 않음.** NBC News에 따르면, 그의 체포가 그녀를 집권하게 만든 계기였다는 점을 감안할 때 이는 주목할 만한 누락이다.

segments.src: ## The domestic picture
segments.tr: ## 국내 상황

segments.src: The speech landed in a country still under strain.
segments.tr: 연설은 여전히 압박을 받고 있는 국내로 전해졌다.

segments.src: CSIS describes the U.S.
segments.tr: CSIS는 1월 이후 미국의

segments.src: approach after January as a three-stage plan of stabilization, recovery and transition.
segments.tr: 접근 방식을 안정화, 회복, 전환의 3단계 계획으로 묘사한다.

segments.src: In its assessment, the first stage is largely complete, the second is underway but uneven, and the third, political transition, has stalled.
segments.tr: 그들의 평가에 따르면 첫 번째 단계는 대부분 완료되었고, 두 번째 단계는 진행 중이지만 고르지 못하며, 세 번째 단계인 정치적 전환은 정체되었다.

segments.src: Some key data points from that analysis:
segments.tr: 해당 분석에서 도출된 몇 가지 주요 데이터 포인트:

segments.src: - An amnesty law freed roughly one thousand detainees, but hundreds reportedly remain in custody.
segments.tr: - 사면법으로 약 1,000명의 구금자가 풀려났으나 수백 명은 여전히 구금되어 있는 것으로 전해진다.

segments.src: - The U.S. eased oil-sector restrictions, opening the door to major energy investment.
segments.tr: - 미국은 석유 부문 제재를 완화하여 주요 에너지 투자의 문을 열었다.

segments.src: - Ordinary Venezuelans have seen little relief. CSIS reports year-over-year inflation of about 534 percent and a frozen minimum wage that covers a tiny fraction of monthly food costs.
segments.tr: - 평범한 베네수엘라 국민들이 체감하는 구제책은 거의 없다. CSIS는 전년 대비 인플레이션이 약 534%에 달하며 월 식품 비용의 극히 일부만을 충당하는 동결된 최저임금을 보고하고 있다.

segments.src: The opposition is also divided.
segments.tr: 야권 또한 분열되어 있다.

segments.src: According to CSIS, one faction, led by Dinorah Figuera, is negotiating gradual institutional reforms.
segments.tr: CSIS에 따르면, 디노라 피게라가 이끄는 한 정파는 점진적인 제도 개혁을 협상하고 있다.

segments.src: Another, led by María Corina Machado, who has not been able to return to Venezuela, argues that the 2024 vote already settled the question of legitimacy and is pressing for immediate presidential elections.
segments.tr: 베네수엘라로 돌아오지 못한 마리아 코리나 마차도가 이끄는 또 다른 정파는 2024년 투표로 이미 정당성 문제가 해결되었다고 주장하며 조속한 대선 실시를 촉구하고 있다.

segments.src: Reports say a first round of talks between the opposition and the interim government began on August 6, and a second round started on September 15.
segments.tr: 보도에 따르면 야권과 과도 정부 간의 1차 협상은 8월 6일에 시작되었고 2차 협상은 9월 15일에 시작되었다.

segments.src: ## How Washington may respond
segments.tr: ## 워싱턴의 대응 방향

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국의

segments.src: position is not a single message.
segments.tr: 입장은 단일한 메시지가 아니다.

segments.src: Reporting points to at least two currents:
segments.tr: 보도에 따르면 적어도 두 가지 흐름이 존재한다:

segments.src: 1. **The economic track.** President Trump has emphasized energy deals and normalized relations. He has also said Venezuela is "not ready yet" for elections, without offering a date. His conversation with Rodríguez was reported as warm and friendly, but also direct about the need for elections eventually.
segments.tr: 1. **경제 트랙.** 트럼프 대통령은 에너지 협정과 관계 정상화를 강조했다. 그는 또한 날짜를 제시하지 않은 채 베네수엘라가 아직 선거를 치를 "준비가 되지 않았다"고 말했다. 로드리게스와의 대화는 따뜻하고 우호적이었다고 보도되었으나, 결국 선거가 필요하다는 점에 대해서는 직설적이었다.

segments.src: 2. **The democratic-reform track.** Secretary of State Marco Rubio has stressed that "democratic elections are not simply about holding an election." He has cited conditions such as press freedom, freedom for all parties to organize, and reform of the electoral council. He has also suggested Venezuela's transition could move far faster than the multi-year transitions seen in Eastern Europe.
segments.tr: 2. **민주주의 개혁 트랙.** 마코 루비오 국무장관은 "민주주의 선거는 단순히 선거를 치르는 것만이 아니다"라고 역설했다. 그는 언론의 자유, 모든 정당의 조직 활동 자유, 선거위원회 개혁 등의 조건을 언급했다. 그는 또한 베네수엘라의 전환이 동유럽에서 목격된 수년 간의 전환보다 훨씬 빠르게 진행될 수 있음을 시사했다.

segments.src: CSIS argues these mixed signals may reduce the urgency of the political transition, and it raises a sequencing question: should institutional reforms come before long-term economic agreements, or after?
segments.tr: CSIS는 이러한 엇갈린 신호가 정치적 전환의 시급성을 떨어뜨릴 수 있으며, 제도 개혁이 장기 경제 협정보다 먼저 와야 하는지 아니면 나중에 와야 하는지라는 순서의 문제를 제기한다고 주장한다.

segments.src: Supporters of the current approach say stability and investment come first.
segments.tr: 현재의 접근 방식을 지지하는 이들은 안정과 투자가 먼저라고 말한다.

segments.src: Critics worry that deals could outlast any democratic commitments.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 거래가 어떤 민주적 약속보다 오래 지속될까 우려한다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 다음 행보

segments.src: - **An electoral calendar.** The clearest sign of progress would be a specific date or a published roadmap.
segments.tr: - **선거 일정.** 진전의 가장 확실한 신호는 구체적인 날짜나 공개된 로드맵일 것이다.

segments.src: - **Electoral council reform and voter-roll updates.** These are practical prerequisites that outside observers will look for.
segments.tr: - **선거위원회 개혁 및 유권자 명부 업데이트.** 이는 외부 관찰자들이 주목할 실질적인 전제 조건이다.

segments.src: - **Outcomes from the opposition talks.** Whether the two rounds of negotiations produce written commitments, and whether the divided opposition can present a common position.
segments.tr: - **야권 협상 결과.** 두 차례의 협상이 서면 약속을 이끌어내는지, 그리고 분열된 야권이 공통된 입장을 제시할 수 있는지 여부.

segments.src: - **Prisoner releases and press freedom.** Rubio's stated conditions give Washington measurable tests to apply.
segments.tr: - **수감자 석방과 언론의 자유.** 루비오 장관이 밝힌 조건들은 워싱턴이 적용할 수 있는 측정 가능한 테스트를 제공한다.

segments.src: - **U.S. policy coordination.** Whether the White House and the State Department align on how much weight to give elections relative to energy and security cooperation.
segments.tr: - **미국 정책 조율.** 백악관과 국무부가 에너지 및 안보 협력에 비해 선거에 얼마나 많은 비중을 두어야 할지 입장을 조율하는지 여부.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Rodríguez's address gave the international community a public commitment it can now refer back to: elections will be held.
segments.tr: 로드리게스의 연설은 국제사회에 이제 다시 언급할 수 있는 공개적인 약속, 즉 선거가 치러질 것이라는 약속을 안겨주었다.

segments.src: But a pledge without a date, a named process or concrete reforms leaves the central question open.
segments.tr: 그러나 날짜, 명시된 프로세스, 구체적인 개혁이 없는 공약은 핵심 질문을 미해결 상태로 남겨둔다.

segments.src: Whether September 23 is remembered as the start of a real transition or as a carefully worded holding statement will depend on what happens in the talks, in Caracas and in Washington over the coming months.
segments.tr: 9월 23일이 진정한 전환의 시작으로 기억될지, 아니면 신중하게 조율된 현상 유지 성명으로 기억될지는 다가오는 몇 달 동안 카라카스와 워싱턴, 그리고 협상에서 일어나는 일에 달려 있을 것이다.

segments.src: *This article is a summary of publicly available reporting and analysis as of late September 2026.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 2026년 9월 말 기준으로 공개적으로 입수 가능한 보도와 분석을 요약한 것이다.

segments.src: Details of an evolving situation may change, and some figures come from single analytical sources as noted.
segments.tr: 진행 중인 상황의 세부 사항은 변경될 수 있으며, 일부 수치는 명시된 바와 같이 단일 분석 출처에서 비롯된다.

zh.title: "将举行选举"：德尔西·罗德里格斯在联合国的第一场演讲揭示了委内瑞拉后马杜罗时代的道路

segments.src: Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, took the podium at the United Nations General Assembly on September 23, 2026, and told world leaders that "elections will be held in Venezuela."
segments.tr: 委内瑞拉代总统德尔西·罗德里格斯（Delcy Rodríguez）于2026年9月23日在联合国大会上登台发言，向世界领导人表示"委内瑞拉将举行选举"。

segments.src: What she did not say was when.
segments.tr: 但她没有说明具体时间。

segments.src: Nearly nine months after U.S.
segments.tr: 在美军于1月抓捕尼古拉斯·马杜罗近九个月后，这场演讲提供了一个承诺、一种与华盛顿和解的基调，但具体细节却非常少。

segments.src: forces captured Nicolás Maduro in January, the speech offered a promise, a tone of reconciliation with Washington, and very few specifics.

This explainer covers what she said, what was missing, and how the United States and Venezuela's opposition may respond, based on reporting from NBC News, NPR, UPI and analysis from the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS).
segments.tr: 本文基于NBC新闻（NBC News）、NPR、合众国际社（UPI）的报道以及战略与国际问题研究中心（CSIS）的分析，介绍了她说了什么、缺少了什么，以及美国和委内瑞拉反对派可能做出怎样的反应。

segments.src: ## Why this speech matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么这场演讲很重要

segments.src: Rodríguez's appearance carried symbolic weight before she said a word.
segments.tr: 罗德里格斯的亮相在她开口之前就已经承载了象征意义。

segments.src: Reports describe it as the first visit to the United States by a Venezuelan head of state since 2018, when Maduro himself traveled to New York for the General Assembly.
segments.tr: 据报道，这是自2018年马杜罗本人前往纽约参加联大以来，委内瑞拉国家元首首次访问美国。

segments.src: She took over after a surprise U.S.
segments.tr: 她在1月美国突击军事行动抓捕马杜罗并将其带到美国面对贩毒指控后接权。

segments.src: military operation in January that captured Maduro and brought him to the United States to face drug trafficking charges.
Since then, her government and Washington have moved from confrontation toward a working, if uneasy, relationship.
segments.tr: 从那时起，她的政府与华盛顿的关系已从对抗转向了工作关系，尽管这种关系并不轻松。

segments.src: Standing at the UN lectern, Rodríguez was presenting Venezuela's new chapter to the world for the first time.
segments.tr: 站在联合国的讲台上，罗德里格斯首次向世界展示了委内瑞拉的新篇章。

segments.src: ## What she said
segments.tr: ## 她说了什么

segments.src: According to news reports, the main points of the address were:
segments.tr: 据新闻报道，演讲的主要要点包括：

segments.src: - **A pledge of elections.** "Elections will be held in Venezuela," she said, adding that the Venezuelan people will determine the "right moment" to move the process forward.
segments.tr: - **关于选举的承诺。** "委内瑞拉将举行选举，"她说道，并补充称委内瑞拉人民将决定推进这一进程的"正确时刻"。

segments.src: - **A dialogue with the opposition.** She said her government has begun a "political dialogue with opposition sectors" aimed at a process "based on equal conditions for all."
segments.tr: - **与反对派对话。** 她表示，她的政府已经开始与"反对派各界"进行"政治对话"，旨在实现一个"基于所有人平等条件"的进程。

segments.src: - **Institutional readiness.** When a vote does take place, she said, the country's institutions "will be prepared to guarantee an inclusive and transparent process."
segments.tr: - **机构准备就绪。** 她表示，一旦投票举行，国家的各项机构"将准备好保证一个包容且透明的进程"。

segments.src: - **A definition of democracy.** "Democracy is not measured by the mere existence of elections," she argued. It is measured, in her words, by the quality of the competition that comes before them.
segments.tr: - **对民主的定义。** 她辩称："民主不单单由选举的存在来衡量。"用她的话说，它是通过选举之前竞争的质量来衡量的。

segments.src: - **A message of renewal.** "Today, Venezuela is being reborn," she said, while cautioning, "I do not promise you an easy way forward." She described rebuilding the country's "national soul" as a priority.
segments.tr: - **革新的信息。** "今天，委内瑞拉正在重获新生，"她说道，同时警告称："我并不向你们承诺一条轻松的前进道路。"她将重建国家的"民族灵魂"描述为一项优先任务。

segments.src: - **Thanks to Washington.** She thanked President Donald Trump and his administration for their willingness to restore diplomatic ties and described a recent meeting as "historic." She named energy, economic cooperation, security and the fight against transnational crime as areas of shared interest, and called a recent oil agreement one of the largest ever reached between the two countries.
segments.tr: - **感谢华盛顿。** 她感谢唐纳德·特朗普总统及其政府愿意恢复外交关系，并将最近的一次会晤形容为"历史性的"。她将能源、经济合作、安全以及打击跨国犯罪列为共同利益领域，并称最近的一项石油协议是两国之间达成的最大协议之一。

segments.src: ## What she left out
segments.tr: ## 她遗漏了什么

segments.src: Several observers noted the gaps as much as the promises.
segments.tr: 几位观察人士既注意到了这些承诺，也注意到了其中的空白。

segments.src: - **No date.** The most important detail for any election, the calendar, was absent. She offered no timeline and no benchmarks for setting one.
segments.tr: - **没有日期。** 对于任何选举来说最重要的细节——日程表，完全不见踪影。她没有提供时间表，也没有提供设定时间表的基准。

segments.src: - **No named negotiating partners.** She referred to "opposition sectors" without identifying which groups are at the table.
segments.tr: - **没有点名谈判伙伴。** 她提到了"反对派各界"，但没有指明哪些团体坐上了谈判桌。

segments.src: - **No detail on judicial or electoral reform.** Independent analysts point out that credible elections usually depend on an updated voter roll and a restructured electoral authority. CSIS reports that no restructuring of the National Electoral Council has been discussed, and that voter rolls remain outdated.
segments.tr: - **没有关于司法或选举改革的细节。** 独立分析人士指出，可信的选举通常取决于更新的选民名册和重组的选举机构。CSIS报告称，各方并未讨论对国家选举委员会进行重组，且选民名册依然过时。

segments.src: - **No direct response to the UN's own findings.** A UN fact-finding mission recently reported that Venezuela's repressive apparatus "remains entirely intact," and that rights violations continue despite improvements. Rodríguez's speech did not directly address that assessment.
segments.tr: - **没有直接回应联合国自身的调查结果。** 联合国的一个实况调查团最近报告称，委内瑞拉的镇压机器"仍然完好无损"，尽管有所改善，但侵犯人权的行为仍在继续。罗德里格斯的演讲没有直接回应这一评估。

segments.src: - **No mention of Maduro by name,** according to NBC News, a notable omission given that his capture is what brought her to office.
segments.tr: - **据NBC新闻报道，演讲中没有提及马杜罗的名字，** 鉴于正是他的被捕才使她走上权力宝座，这是一个明显的遗漏。

segments.src: ## The domestic picture
segments.tr: ## 国内局势

segments.src: The speech landed in a country still under strain.
segments.tr: 这场演讲发表在一个仍然承受着压力的国家。

segments.src: CSIS describes the U.S.
segments.tr: CSIS将美国在1月之后的方案描述为稳定、复苏和过渡的三阶段计划。

segments.src: approach after January as a three-stage plan of stabilization, recovery and transition.
In its assessment, the first stage is largely complete, the second is underway but uneven, and the third, political transition, has stalled.
segments.tr: 根据其评估，第一阶段基本完成，第二阶段正在进行但进展不均衡，而第三阶段即政治过渡则陷入停滞。

segments.src: Some key data points from that analysis:
segments.tr: 该分析的一些关键数据点包括：

segments.src: - An amnesty law freed roughly one thousand detainees, but hundreds reportedly remain in custody.
segments.tr: - 一项大赦法释放了大约一千名被拘留者，但据报道仍有数百人被关押。

segments.src: - The U.S. eased oil-sector restrictions, opening the door to major energy investment.
segments.tr: - 美国放松了对石油行业的限制，为重大能源投资打开了大门。

segments.src: - Ordinary Venezuelans have seen little relief. CSIS reports year-over-year inflation of about 534 percent and a frozen minimum wage that covers a tiny fraction of monthly food costs.
segments.tr: - 普通委内瑞拉人几乎没有看到什么缓解。CSIS报告称，同比通货膨胀率约为534%，而冻结的最低工资仅能覆盖每月食品成本的一小部分。

segments.src: The opposition is also divided.
segments.tr: 反对派也出现了分裂。

segments.src: According to CSIS, one faction, led by Dinorah Figuera, is negotiating gradual institutional reforms.
segments.tr: 据CSIS称，由迪诺拉·菲格拉（Dinorah Figuera）领导的一个派别正在谈判逐步的制度改革。

segments.src: Another, led by María Corina Machado, who has not been able to return to Venezuela, argues that the 2024 vote already settled the question of legitimacy and is pressing for immediate presidential elections.
segments.tr: 另一派由玛丽亚·科丽娜·马查多（María Corina Machado）领导（她未能返回委内瑞拉），该派别认为2024年的投票已经解决了合法性问题，并一直在敦促立即举行总统选举。

segments.src: Reports say a first round of talks between the opposition and the interim government began on August 6, and a second round started on September 15.
segments.tr: 报道称，反对派与临时政府之间的第一轮会谈于8月6日开始，第二轮会谈于9月15日开始。

segments.src: ## How Washington may respond
segments.tr: ## 华盛顿可能如何回应

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国的立场并非单一的声音。

segments.src: position is not a single message.
Reporting points to at least two currents:
segments.tr: 报道指向了至少两种倾向：

segments.src: 1. **The economic track.** President Trump has emphasized energy deals and normalized relations. He has also said Venezuela is "not ready yet" for elections, without offering a date. His conversation with Rodríguez was reported as warm and friendly, but also direct about the need for elections eventually.
segments.tr: 1. **经济轨道。** 特朗普总统强调了能源交易和关系正常化。他还表示，委内瑞拉"尚未准备好"举行选举，但没有提供日期。据报道，他与罗德里格斯的交谈温暖而友好，但也明确指出了最终需要举行选举的必要性。

segments.src: 2. **The democratic-reform track.** Secretary of State Marco Rubio has stressed that "democratic elections are not simply about holding an election." He has cited conditions such as press freedom, freedom for all parties to organize, and reform of the electoral council. He has also suggested Venezuela's transition could move far faster than the multi-year transitions seen in Eastern Europe.
segments.tr: 2. **民主改革轨道。** 国务卿马可·鲁比奥强调，"民主选举不仅仅是举行一场选举。"他列举了一些条件，例如新闻自由、所有政党组织活动的自由以及选举委员会的改革。他还暗示，委内瑞拉的过渡速度可能会比东欧看到的多年过渡要快得多。

segments.src: CSIS argues these mixed signals may reduce the urgency of the political transition, and it raises a sequencing question: should institutional reforms come before long-term economic agreements, or after?
segments.tr: CSIS认为，这些复杂的信号可能会降低政治过渡的紧迫性，并提出了一个先后顺序的问题：制度改革应该在长期经济协议之前进行，还是之后？

segments.src: Supporters of the current approach say stability and investment come first.
segments.tr: 当前路线的支持者表示，稳定和投资应当排在首位。

segments.src: Critics worry that deals could outlast any democratic commitments.
segments.tr: 批评者则担心，协议可能会比任何民主承诺都更持久。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来需要关注什么

segments.src: - **An electoral calendar.** The clearest sign of progress would be a specific date or a published roadmap.
segments.tr: - **选举日程表。** 取得进展的最清晰标志将是一个具体的日期或已公布的路线图。

segments.src: - **Electoral council reform and voter-roll updates.** These are practical prerequisites that outside observers will look for.
segments.tr: - **选举委员会改革和选民名册更新。** 这些是外部观察员将会寻找的实际先决条件。

segments.src: - **Outcomes from the opposition talks.** Whether the two rounds of negotiations produce written commitments, and whether the divided opposition can present a common position.
segments.tr: - **反对派会谈的结果。** 两轮谈判是否会产生书面承诺，以及分裂的反对派能否提出共同立场。

segments.src: - **Prisoner releases and press freedom.** Rubio's stated conditions give Washington measurable tests to apply.
segments.tr: - **释放囚犯与新闻自由。** 鲁比奥陈述的条件为华盛顿提供了可衡量的检验标准。

segments.src: - **U.S. policy coordination.** Whether the White House and the State Department align on how much weight to give elections relative to energy and security cooperation.
segments.tr: - **美国政策协调。** 白宫与国务院是否会在赋予选举多少权重（相对于能源和安全合作）的问题上保持一致。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Rodríguez's address gave the international community a public commitment it can now refer back to: elections will be held.
segments.tr: 罗德里格斯的演讲给予了国际社会一个可以引用的公开承诺：将举行选举。

segments.src: But a pledge without a date, a named process or concrete reforms leaves the central question open.
segments.tr: 但一个没有日期、没有具名进程或具体改革的承诺，让核心问题悬而未决。

segments.src: Whether September 23 is remembered as the start of a real transition or as a carefully worded holding statement will depend on what happens in the talks, in Caracas and in Washington over the coming months.
segments.tr: 9月23日是被人们铭记为真正过渡的开始，还是被视为一份措辞谨慎的权宜声明，将取决于未来几个月在加拉加斯和华盛顿的谈判中发生的事情。

segments.tr: *本文是截至2026年9月下旬公开报道和分析的摘要。

segments.tr: 本文仅供一般信息参考。*

segments.tr: - **विपक्ष के साथ बातचीत।** उन्होंने कहा कि उनकी सरकार ने "सभी के लिए समान परिस्थितियों पर आधारित" प्रक्रिया के उद्देश्य से "विपक्षी क्षेत्रों के साथ राजनीतिक संवाद" शुरू किया है।

segments.src: - **Institutional readiness.** When a vote does take place, she said, the country's institutions "will be prepared to guarantee an inclusive and transparent process."
segments.tr: - **संस्थागत तत्परता।** उन्होंने कहा कि जब मतदान होगा, तो देश के संस्थान "एक समावेशी और पारदर्शी प्रक्रिया की गारंटी देने के लिए तैयार होंगे।"

segments.src: - **A definition of democracy.** "Democracy is not measured by the mere existence of elections," she argued. It is measured, in her words, by the quality of the competition that comes before them.
segments.tr: - **लोकतंत्र की परिभाषा।** उन्होंने तर्क दिया, "लोकतंत्र को केवल चुनावों के अस्तित्व से नहीं मापा जाता है।" उनके शब्दों में, इसे चुनाव से पहले होने वाली प्रतिस्पर्धा की गुणवत्ता से मापा जाता है।

segments.src: - **A message of renewal.** "Today, Venezuela is being reborn," she said, while cautioning, "I do not promise you an easy way forward." She described rebuilding the country's "national soul" as a priority.
segments.tr: - **नवीनीकरण का संदेश।** "आज, वेनेजुएला का पुनर्जन्म हो रहा है," उन्होंने चेतावनी देते हुए कहा, "मैं आपसे आगे के आसान रास्ते का वादा नहीं करती।" उन्होंने देश की "राष्ट्रीय आत्मा" के पुनर्निर्माण को प्राथमिकता बताया।

segments.src: - **Thanks to Washington.** She thanked President Donald Trump and his administration for their willingness to restore diplomatic ties and described a recent meeting as "historic." She named energy, economic cooperation, security and the fight against transnational crime as areas of shared interest, and called a recent oil agreement one of the largest ever reached between the two countries.
segments.tr: - **वाशिंगटन को धन्यवाद।** उन्होंने राजनयिक संबंधों को बहाल करने की इच्छा के लिए राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प और उनके प्रशासन को धन्यवाद दिया और हाल की एक बैठक को "ऐतिहासिक" बताया। उन्होंने ऊर्जा, आर्थिक सहयोग, सुरक्षा और अंतरराष्ट्रीय अपराध के खिलाफ लड़ाई को साझा हित के क्षेत्रों के रूप में नामित किया, और हाल के तेल समझौते को दोनों देशों के बीच अब तक के सबसे बड़े समझौतों में से एक बताया।

segments.src: ## What she left out
segments.tr: ## उन्होंने क्या छोड़ दिया

segments.src: Several observers noted the gaps as much as the promises.
segments.tr: कई विश्लेषकों ने वादों के साथ-साथ कमियों को भी रेखांकित किया।

segments.src: - **No date.** The most important detail for any election, the calendar, was absent. She offered no timeline and no benchmarks for setting one.
segments.tr: - **कोई तारीख नहीं।** किसी भी चुनाव के लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण विवरण, यानी कैलेंडर, गायब था। उन्होंने कोई समयसीमा या इसे तय करने के लिए कोई मानक पेश नहीं किया।

segments.src: - **No named negotiating partners.** She referred to "opposition sectors" without identifying which groups are at the table.
segments.tr: - **वार्ताकारों के नाम नहीं।** उन्होंने यह स्पष्ट किए बिना कि कौन से समूह बातचीत की मेज पर हैं, केवल "विपक्षी क्षेत्रों" का उल्लेख किया।

segments.src: - **No detail on judicial or electoral reform.** Independent analysts point out that credible elections usually depend on an updated voter roll and a restructured electoral authority. CSIS reports that no restructuring of the National Electoral Council has been discussed, and that voter rolls remain outdated.
segments.tr: - **न्यायिक या चुनावी सुधार पर कोई विवरण नहीं।** स्वतंत्र विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि विश्वसनीय चुनाव आमतौर पर एक अद्यतन मतदाता सूची और एक पुनर्गठित चुनावी प्राधिकरण पर निर्भर करते हैं। CSIS की रिपोर्ट है कि राष्ट्रीय चुनावी परिषद के किसी भी पुनर्गठन पर चर्चा नहीं की गई है, और मतदाता सूची अभी भी पुरानी है।

segments.src: - **No direct response to the UN's own findings.** A UN fact-finding mission recently reported that Venezuela's repressive apparatus "remains entirely intact," and that rights violations continue despite improvements. Rodríguez's speech did not directly address that assessment.
segments.tr: - **संयुक्त राष्ट्र के अपने निष्कर्षों पर कोई सीधा जवाब नहीं।** संयुक्त राष्ट्र के एक तथ्य-खोज मिशन ने हाल ही में रिपोर्ट दी थी कि वेनेजुएला का दमनकारी तंत्र "पूरी तरह से बरकरार है," और सुधारों के बावजूद मानवाधिकारों का उल्लंघन जारी है। रोड्रिग्ज के भाषण में उस आकलन का सीधे तौर पर कोई जिक्र नहीं किया गया।

segments.src: - **No mention of Maduro by name,** according to NBC News, a notable omission given that his capture is what brought her to office.
segments.tr: - **मादुरो का नाम लेकर कोई उल्लेख नहीं,** NBC News के अनुसार, यह एक उल्लेखनीय चूक है क्योंकि उनकी गिरफ्तारी के कारण ही वह सत्ता में आई हैं।

segments.src: ## The domestic picture
segments.tr: ## घरेलू स्थिति

segments.src: The speech landed in a country still under strain.
segments.tr: यह भाषण एक ऐसे देश में दिया गया जो अभी भी तनाव में है।

segments.src: CSIS describes the U.S.
segments.tr: CSIS जनवरी के बाद के अमेरिकी

segments.src: approach after January as a three-stage plan of stabilization, recovery and transition.
segments.tr: दृष्टिकोण को स्थिरता, सुधार और संक्रमण की तीन-चरणीय योजना के रूप में वर्णित करता है।

segments.src: In its assessment, the first stage is largely complete, the second is underway but uneven, and the third, political transition, has stalled.
segments.tr: इसके आकलन में, पहला चरण काफी हद तक पूरा हो चुका है, दूसरा चरण जारी है लेकिन असमान है, और तीसरा चरण, यानी राजनीतिक संक्रमण, रुक गया है।

segments.src: Some key data points from that analysis:
segments.tr: उस विश्लेषण के कुछ प्रमुख डेटा बिंदु:

segments.src: - An amnesty law freed roughly one thousand detainees, but hundreds reportedly remain in custody.
segments.tr: - एक माफी कानून ने लगभग एक हजार बंदियों को रिहा कर दिया, लेकिन कथित तौर पर सैकड़ों अभी भी हिरासत में हैं।

segments.src: - The U.S. eased oil-sector restrictions, opening the door to major energy investment.
segments.tr: - अमेरिका ने तेल क्षेत्र के प्रतिबंधों में ढील दी, जिससे बड़े ऊर्जा निवेश का रास्ता साफ हुआ।

segments.src: - Ordinary Venezuelans have seen little relief. CSIS reports year-over-year inflation of about 534 percent and a frozen minimum wage that covers a tiny fraction of monthly food costs.
segments.tr: - आम वेनेजुएला वासियों को बहुत कम राहत मिली है। CSIS की रिपोर्ट है कि साल-दर-साल मुद्रास्फीति लगभग 534 प्रतिशत है और न्यूनतम वेतन स्थिर है जो मासिक खाद्य लागत के एक बहुत छोटे हिस्से को ही पूरा करता है।

segments.src: The opposition is also divided.
segments.tr: विपक्ष भी बंटा हुआ है।

segments.src: According to CSIS, one faction, led by Dinorah Figuera, is negotiating gradual institutional reforms.
segments.tr: CSIS के अनुसार, दिनोरा फिगुएरा के नेतृत्व वाला एक गुट क्रमिक संस्थागत सुधारों पर बातचीत कर रहा है।

segments.src: Another, led by María Corina Machado, who has not been able to return to Venezuela, argues that the 2024 vote already settled the question of legitimacy and is pressing for immediate presidential elections.
segments.tr: मारिया कोरीना मचाडो के नेतृत्व वाला दूसरा गुट, जो वेनेजुएला लौटने में असमर्थ रही हैं, का तर्क है कि 2024 के मतदान ने वैधता के सवाल को पहले ही तय कर दिया है और वे तत्काल राष्ट्रपति चुनाव के लिए दबाव बना रहे हैं।

segments.src: Reports say a first round of talks between the opposition and the interim government began on August 6, and a second round started on September 15.
segments.tr: रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, विपक्ष और अंतरिम सरकार के बीच बातचीत का पहला दौर 6 अगस्त को शुरू हुआ था, और दूसरा दौर 15 सितंबर को शुरू हुआ।

segments.src: ## How Washington may respond
segments.tr: ## वाशिंगटन कैसे प्रतिक्रिया दे सकता है

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिका का

segments.src: position is not a single message.
segments.tr: रुख कोई एक संदेश नहीं है।

segments.src: Reporting points to at least two currents:
segments.tr: रिपोर्टिंग कम से कम दो धाराओं की ओर इशारा करती है:

segments.src: 1. **The economic track.** President Trump has emphasized energy deals and normalized relations. He has also said Venezuela is "not ready yet" for elections, without offering a date. His conversation with Rodríguez was reported as warm and friendly, but also direct about the need for elections eventually.
segments.tr: 1. **आर्थिक मार्ग।** राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प ने ऊर्जा समझौतों और सामान्य संबंधों पर जोर दिया है। उन्होंने बिना कोई तारीख दिए यह भी कहा है कि वेनेजुएला अभी चुनावों के लिए "तैयार नहीं है"। रोड्रिग्ज के साथ उनकी बातचीत को गर्मजोशी से भरा और मैत्रीपूर्ण बताया गया, लेकिन अंततः चुनावों की आवश्यकता के बारे में सीधी भी थी।

segments.src: 2. **The democratic-reform track.** Secretary of State Marco Rubio has stressed that "democratic elections are not simply about holding an election." He has cited conditions such as press freedom, freedom for all parties to organize, and reform of the electoral council. He has also suggested Venezuela's transition could move far faster than the multi-year transitions seen in Eastern Europe.
segments.tr: 2. **लोकतांत्रिक-सुधार मार्ग।** विदेश मंत्री मार्को रुबियो ने इस बात पर जोर दिया है कि "लोकतांत्रिक चुनाव केवल चुनाव कराने के बारे में नहीं हैं।" उन्होंने प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता, सभी दलों को संगठित होने की स्वतंत्रता और चुनावी परिषद के सुधार जैसी शर्तों का हवाला दिया है। उन्होंने यह भी सुझाव दिया है कि वेनेजुएला का संक्रमण पूर्वी यूरोप में देखे गए बहु-वर्षीय संक्रमणों की तुलना में बहुत तेजी से आगे बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: CSIS argues these mixed signals may reduce the urgency of the political transition, and it raises a sequencing question: should institutional reforms come before long-term economic agreements, or after?
segments.tr: CSIS का तर्क है कि ये मिश्रित संकेत राजनीतिक संक्रमण की तात्कालिकता को कम कर सकते हैं, और यह एक अनुक्रमिक प्रश्न उठाता है: क्या संस्थागत सुधार दीर्घकालिक आर्थिक समझौतों से पहले होने चाहिए, या बाद में?

segments.src: Supporters of the current approach say stability and investment come first.
segments.tr: वर्तमान दृष्टिकोण के समर्थकों का कहना है कि स्थिरता और निवेश पहले आते हैं।

segments.src: Critics worry that deals could outlast any democratic commitments.
segments.tr: आलोचकों को चिंता है कि समझौते किसी भी लोकतांत्रिक प्रतिबद्धताओं से अधिक समय तक टिक सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **An electoral calendar.** The clearest sign of progress would be a specific date or a published roadmap.
segments.tr: - **एक चुनावी कैलेंडर।** प्रगति का सबसे स्पष्ट संकेत एक विशिष्ट तिथि या एक प्रकाशित रोडमैप होगा।

segments.src: - **Electoral council reform and voter-roll updates.** These are practical prerequisites that outside observers will look for.
segments.tr: - **चुनावी परिषद सुधार और मतदाता सूची का अद्यतन।** ये व्यावहारिक आवश्यकताएं हैं जिन पर बाहरी पर्यवेक्षक नजर रखेंगे।

segments.src: - **Outcomes from the opposition talks.** Whether the two rounds of negotiations produce written commitments, and whether the divided opposition can present a common position.
segments.tr: - **विपक्ष की बातचीत के परिणाम।** क्या बातचीत के दो दौर लिखित प्रतिबद्धताओं को जन्म देते हैं, और क्या विभाजित विपक्ष एक साझा रुख पेश कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Prisoner releases and press freedom.** Rubio's stated conditions give Washington measurable tests to apply.
segments.tr: - **कैदियों की रिहाई और प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता।** रुबियो की घोषित शर्तें वाशिंगटन को लागू करने के लिए मापने योग्य परीक्षण देती हैं।

segments.src: - **U.S. policy coordination.** Whether the White House and the State Department align on how much weight to give elections relative to energy and security cooperation.
segments.tr: - **अमेरिकी नीति समन्वय।** क्या व्हाइट हाउस और विदेश विभाग इस बात पर सहमत हैं कि ऊर्जा और सुरक्षा सहयोग की तुलना में चुनावों को कितना महत्व दिया जाए।

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Rodríguez's address gave the international community a public commitment it can now refer back to: elections will be held.
segments.tr: रोड्रिग्ज के संबोधन ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय समुदाय को एक सार्वजनिक प्रतिबद्धता दी है जिसका वे अब संदर्भ ले सकते हैं: चुनाव होंगे।

segments.src: But a pledge without a date, a named process or concrete reforms leaves the central question open.
segments.tr: लेकिन बिना किसी तारीख, नामित प्रक्रिया या ठोस सुधारों के एक संकल्प केंद्रीय प्रश्न को खुला छोड़ देता है।

segments.src: Whether September 23 is remembered as the start of a real transition or as a carefully worded holding statement will depend on what happens in the talks, in Caracas and in Washington over the coming months.
segments.tr: क्या 23 सितंबर को एक वास्तविक संक्रमण की शुरुआत के रूप में याद किया जाएगा या सावधानीपूर्वक तैयार किए गए एक होल्डिंग बयान के रूप में, यह आने वाले महीनों में काराकास और वाशिंगटन में होने वाली वार्ताओं पर निर्भर करेगा।

segments.src: *This article is a summary of publicly available reporting and analysis as of late September 2026.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सितंबर 2026 के अंत तक सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध रिपोर्टिंग और विश्लेषण का एक सारांश है।

segments.src: Details of an evolving situation may change, and some figures come from single analytical sources as noted.
segments.tr: एक विकसित होती स्थिति के विवरण बदल सकते हैं, और कुछ आंकड़े एकल विश्लेषणात्मक स्रोतों से आते हैं जैसा कि उल्लेख किया गया है।

segments.src: It is provided for general informational purposes only.*
segments.tr: यह केवल सामान्य सूचनात्मक उद्देश्यों के लिए प्रदान किया गया है।*

es.title: "Habrá elecciones": lo que revela el primer discurso de Delcy Rodríguez ante la ONU sobre el camino post-Maduro de Venezuela

segments.src: Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, took the podium at the United Nations General Assembly on September 23, 2026, and told world leaders that "elections will be held in Venezuela."
segments.tr: La presidenta en funciones de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, subió al podio de la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas el 23 de septiembre de 2026 y dijo a los líderes mundiales que "habrá elecciones en Venezuela".

segments.src: What she did not say was when.
segments.tr: Lo que no dijo fue cuándo.

segments.src: Nearly nine months after U.S.
segments.tr: Casi nueve meses después de que las fuerzas de EE. UU.

segments.src: forces captured Nicolás Maduro in January, the speech offered a promise, a tone of reconciliation with Washington, and very few specifics.

segments.src: This explainer covers what she said, what was missing, and how the United States and Venezuela's opposition may respond, based on reporting from NBC News, NPR, UPI and analysis from the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS).

segments.src: ## Why this speech matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa este discurso

segments.src: Rodríguez's appearance carried symbolic weight before she said a word.
segments.tr: La comparecencia de Rodríguez tuvo un peso simbólico antes de que pronunciara una sola palabra.

segments.src: Reports describe it as the first visit to the United States by a Venezuelan head of state since 2018, when Maduro himself traveled to New York for the General Assembly.
segments.tr: Los informes la describen como la primera visita a los Estados Unidos de un jefe de Estado venezolano desde 2018, cuando el propio Maduro viajó a Nueva York para la Asamblea General.

segments.src: She took over after a surprise U.S.
segments.tr: Ella asumió el cargo tras una sorpresiva operación militar de EE. UU.

segments.src: military operation in January that captured Maduro and brought him to the United States to face drug trafficking charges.
segments.tr: en enero que capturó a Maduro y lo llevó a los Estados Unidos para enfrentar cargos de narcotráfico.

segments.src: Since then, her government and Washington have moved from confrontation toward a working, if uneasy, relationship.
segments.tr: Desde entonces, su gobierno y Washington han pasado de la confrontación a una relación de trabajo, aunque incómoda.

segments.src: Standing at the UN lectern, Rodríguez was presenting Venezuela's new chapter to the world for the first time.
segments.tr: De pie en el atril de la ONU, Rodríguez presentaba por primera vez al mundo el nuevo capítulo de Venezuela.

segments.src: ## What she said
segments.tr: ## Qué dijo

segments.src: According to news reports, the main points of the address were:
segments.tr: Según los informes de prensa, los puntos principales del discurso fueron:

segments.src: - **A pledge of elections.** "Elections will be held in Venezuela," she said, adding that the Venezuelan people will determine the "right moment" to move the process forward.
segments.tr: - **Un compromiso de elecciones.** "Habrá elecciones en Venezuela", afirmó, y añadió que el pueblo venezolano determinará el "momento adecuado" para avanzar en el proceso.

segments.src: - **A dialogue with the opposition.** She said her government has begun a "political dialogue with opposition sectors" aimed at a process "based on equal conditions for all."
segments.tr: - **Un diálogo con la oposición.** Dijo que su gobierno ha iniciado un "diálogo político con sectores de la oposición" destinado a un proceso "basado en la igualdad de condiciones para todos".

segments.src: - **Institutional readiness.** When a vote does take place, she said, the country's institutions "will be prepared to guarantee an inclusive and transparent process."
segments.tr: - **Preparación institucional.** Cuando se realice una votación, dijo, las instituciones del país "estarán preparadas para garantizar un proceso inclusivo y transparente".

segments.src: - **A definition of democracy.** "Democracy is not measured by the mere existence of elections," she argued. It is measured, in her words, by the quality of the competition that comes before them.
segments.tr: - **Una definición de democracia.** "La democracia no se mide por la mera existencia de elecciones", argumentó. Se mide, en sus palabras, por la calidad de la competencia que las precede.

segments.src: - **A message of renewal.** "Today, Venezuela is being reborn," she said, while cautioning, "I do not promise you an easy way forward." She described rebuilding the country's "national soul" as a priority.
segments.tr: - **Un mensaje de renovación.** "Hoy, Venezuela está renaciendo", dijo, al tiempo que advirtió: "No les prometo un camino fácil por delante". Describió la reconstrucción del "alma nacional" del país como una prioridad.

segments.src: - **Thanks to Washington.** She thanked President Donald Trump and his administration for their willingness to restore diplomatic ties and described a recent meeting as "historic." She named energy, economic cooperation, security and the fight against transnational crime as areas of shared interest, and called a recent oil agreement one of the largest ever reached between the two countries.
segments.tr: - **Agradecimiento a Washington.** Agradeció al presidente Donald Trump y a su administración por su disposición a restablecer los lazos diplomáticos y describió una reunión reciente como "histórica". Mencionó la energía, la cooperación económica, la seguridad y la lucha contra el crimen transnacional como áreas de interés compartido, y calificó un acuerdo petrolero reciente como uno de los más grandes jamás alcanzados entre ambos países.

segments.src: ## What she left out
segments.tr: ## Qué omitió

segments.src: Several observers noted the gaps as much as the promises.
segments.tr: Varios observadores señalaron tanto los vacíos como las promesas.

segments.src: - **No date.** The most important detail for any election, the calendar, was absent. She offered no timeline and no benchmarks for setting one.
segments.tr: - **Sin fecha.** Faltó el detalle más importante para cualquier elección: el calendario. No ofreció ningún cronograma ni pautas para establecer uno.

segments.src: - **No named negotiating partners.** She referred to "opposition sectors" without identifying which groups are at the table.
segments.tr: - **Sin nombrar a los interlocutores de la negociación.** Se refirió a "sectores de la oposición" sin identificar qué grupos están en la mesa.

segments.src: - **No detail on judicial or electoral reform.** Independent analysts point out that credible elections usually depend on an updated voter roll and a restructured electoral authority. CSIS reports that no restructuring of the National Electoral Council has been discussed, and that voter rolls remain outdated.
segments.tr: - **Sin detalles sobre reformas judiciales o electorales.** Analistas independientes señalan que unas elecciones creíbles suelen depender de un padrón electoral actualizado y de una autoridad electoral reestructurada. El CSIS informa que no se ha discutido ninguna reestructuración del Consejo Nacional Electoral y que los padrones electorales siguen desactualizados.

segments.src: - **No direct response to the UN's own findings.** A UN fact-finding mission recently reported that Venezuela's repressive apparatus "remains entirely intact," and that rights violations continue despite improvements. Rodríguez's speech did not directly address that assessment.
segments.tr: - **Sin respuesta directa a las conclusiones de la propia ONU.** Una misión de determinación de los hechos de la ONU informó recientemente que el aparato represivo de Venezuela "permanece completamente intacto" y que las violaciones de derechos continúan a pesar de las mejoras. El discurso de Rodríguez no abordó directamente esa evaluación.

segments.src: - **No mention of Maduro by name,** according to NBC News, a notable omission given that his capture is what brought her to office.
segments.tr: - **Ninguna mención a Maduro por su nombre,** según NBC News, una omisión notable dado que su captura es lo que la llevó al cargo.

segments.src: ## The domestic picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama interno

segments.src: The speech landed in a country still under strain.
segments.tr: El discurso se pronunció en un país que sigue bajo tensión.

segments.src: CSIS describes the U.S.
segments.tr: El CSIS describe el enfoque de EE. UU.

segments.src: approach after January as a three-stage plan of stabilization, recovery and transition.
segments.tr: después de enero como un plan de tres etapas: estabilización, recuperación y transición.

segments.src: In its assessment, the first stage is largely complete, the second is underway but uneven, and the third, political transition, has stalled.
segments.tr: En su evaluación, la primera etapa está prácticamente completada, la segunda está en marcha pero de manera desigual, y la tercera, la transición política, se ha estancado.

segments.src: Some key data points from that analysis:
segments.tr: Algunos datos clave de ese análisis:

segments.src: - An amnesty law freed roughly one thousand detainees, but hundreds reportedly remain in custody.
segments.tr: - Una ley de amnistía liberó a aproximadamente mil detenidos, pero según se informa, cientos permanecen bajo custodia.

segments.src: - The U.S. eased oil-sector restrictions, opening the door to major energy investment.
segments.tr: - EE. UU. alivió las restricciones al sector petrolero, abriendo la puerta a importantes inversiones energéticas.

segments.src: - Ordinary Venezuelans have seen little relief. CSIS reports year-over-year inflation of about 534 percent and a frozen minimum wage that covers a tiny fraction of monthly food costs.
segments.tr: - Los venezolanos de a pie han visto poco alivio. El CSIS informa de una inflación interanual de alrededor del 534 por ciento y un salario mínimo congelado que cubre una fracción minúscula de los costos mensuales de alimentación.

segments.src: The opposition is also divided.
segments.tr: La oposición también está dividida.

segments.src: According to CSIS, one faction, led by Dinorah Figuera, is negotiating gradual institutional reforms.
segments.tr: Según el CSIS, una facción, liderada por Dinorah Figuera, está negociando reformas institucionales graduales.

segments.src: Another, led by María Corina Machado, who has not been able to return to Venezuela, argues that the 2024 vote already settled the question of legitimacy and is pressing for immediate presidential elections.
segments.tr: Otra, liderada por María Corina Machado, quien no ha podido regresar a Venezuela, sostiene que la votación de 2024 ya resolvió la cuestión de la legitimidad y presiona por elecciones presidenciales inmediatas.

segments.src: Reports say a first round of talks between the opposition and the interim government began on August 6, and a second round started on September 15.
segments.tr: Los informes señalan que una primera ronda de conversaciones entre la oposición y el gobierno interino comenzó el 6 de agosto, y una segunda ronda inició el 15 de septiembre.

segments.src: ## How Washington may respond
segments.tr: ## Cómo podría responder Washington

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: La postura de EE. UU.

segments.src: position is not a single message.
segments.tr: no es un mensaje único.

segments.src: Reporting points to at least two currents:
segments.tr: Los informes apuntan a al menos dos corrientes:

segments.src: 1. **The economic track.** President Trump has emphasized energy deals and normalized relations. He has also said Venezuela is "not ready yet" for elections, without offering a date. His conversation with Rodríguez was reported as warm and friendly, but also direct about the need for elections eventually.
segments.tr: 1. **La vía económica.** El presidente Trump ha hecho hincapié en los acuerdos energéticos y la normalización de relaciones. También ha dicho que Venezuela "aún no está lista" para las elecciones, sin ofrecer una fecha. Se informó que su conversación con Rodríguez fue cálida y amistosa, pero también directa sobre la necesidad de que eventualmente se celebren elecciones.

segments.src: 2. **The democratic-reform track.** Secretary of State Marco Rubio has stressed that "democratic elections are not simply about holding an election." He has cited conditions such as press freedom, freedom for all parties to organize, and reform of the electoral council. He has also suggested Venezuela's transition could move far faster than the multi-year transitions seen in Eastern Europe.
segments.tr: 2. **La vía de la reforma democrática.** El secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, ha subrayado que "las elecciones democráticas no consisten simplemente en celebrar una votación". Ha citado condiciones como la libertad de prensa, la libertad de organización para todos los partidos y la reforma del consejo electoral. También ha sugerido que la transición de Venezuela podría avanzar mucho más rápido que las transiciones de varios años vistas en Europa del Este.

segments.src: CSIS argues these mixed signals may reduce the urgency of the political transition, and it raises a sequencing question: should institutional reforms come before long-term economic agreements, or after?
segments.tr: El CSIS sostiene que estas señales mixtas pueden reducir la urgencia de la transición política, y plantea una cuestión de secuencia: ¿deberían las reformas institucionales ir antes de los acuerdos económicos a largo plazo, o después?

segments.src: Supporters of the current approach say stability and investment come first.
segments.tr: Los partidarios del enfoque actual afirman que la estabilidad y la inversión son lo primero.

segments.src: Critics worry that deals could outlast any democratic commitments.
segments.tr: A los críticos les preocupa que los acuerdos comerciales puedan sobrevivir a cualquier compromiso democrático.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.src: - **An electoral calendar.** The clearest sign of progress would be a specific date or a published roadmap.
segments.tr: - **Un calendario electoral.** La señal más clara de progreso sería una fecha específica o una hoja de ruta publicada.

segments.src: - **Electoral council reform and voter-roll updates.** These are practical prerequisites that outside observers will look for.
segments.tr: - **Reforma del consejo electoral y actualización del padrón de votantes.** Estos son requisitos previos prácticos que buscarán los observadores externos.

segments.src: - **Outcomes from the opposition talks.** Whether the two rounds of negotiations produce written commitments, and whether the divided opposition can present a common position.
segments.tr: - **Resultados de las conversaciones con la oposición.** Si las dos rondas de negociaciones producen compromisos escritos y si la dividida oposición puede presentar una postura común.

segments.src: - **Prisoner releases and press freedom.** Rubio's stated conditions give Washington measurable tests to apply.
segments.tr: - **Liberación de prisioneros y libertad de prensa.** Las condiciones declaradas por Rubio le dan a Washington pruebas medibles para aplicar.

segments.src: - **U.S. policy coordination.** Whether the White House and the State Department align on how much weight to give elections relative to energy and security cooperation.
segments.tr: - **Coordinación de la política de EE. UU.** Si la Casa Blanca y el Departamento de Estado se alinean sobre cuánto peso dar a las elecciones en relación con la cooperación energética y de seguridad.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: Rodríguez's address gave the international community a public commitment it can now refer back to: elections will be held.
segments.tr: El discurso de Rodríguez dio a la comunidad internacional un compromiso público al que ahora puede remitirse: se celebrarán elecciones.

segments.src: But a pledge without a date, a named process or concrete reforms leaves the central question open.
segments.tr: Pero una promesa sin fecha, sin un proceso definido ni reformas concretas deja abierta la cuestión central.

segments.src: Whether September 23 is remembered as the start of a real transition or as a carefully worded holding statement will depend on what happens in the talks, in Caracas and in Washington over the coming months.
segments.tr: El hecho de que el 23 de septiembre se recuerde como el inicio de una transición real o como una declaración de espera cuidadosamente redactada dependerá de lo que suceda en las conversaciones, en Caracas y en Washington durante los próximos meses.

segments.src: ## Bottom line

fr.title: "Des élections auront lieu" : ce que le premier discours de Delcy Rodríguez à l'ONU révèle sur la voie post-Maduro du Venezuela

segments.src: Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, took the podium at the United Nations General Assembly on September 23, 2026, and told world leaders that "elections will be held in Venezuela."
segments.tr: La présidente par intérim du Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, a pris la parole à l'Assemblée générale des Nations Unies le 23 septembre 2026, affirmant aux dirigeants mondiaux que "des élections auront lieu au Venezuela."

segments.src: What she did not say was when.
segments.tr: Ce qu'elle n'a pas dit, c'est quand.

segments.src: Nearly nine months after U.S.
segments.tr: Près de neuf mois après que les forces américaines ont capturé Nicolás Maduro en janvier,

segments.src: forces captured Nicolás Maduro in January, the speech offered a promise, a tone of reconciliation with Washington, and very few specifics.
segments.tr: le discours a offert une promesse, un ton de réconciliation avec Washington, et très peu de précisions.

segments.src: This explainer covers what she said, what was missing, and how the United States and Venezuela's opposition may respond, based on reporting from NBC News, NPR, UPI and analysis from the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS).
segments.tr: Cette note explicative couvre ce qu'elle a dit, ce qui manquait, et comment les États-Unis et l'opposition vénézuélienne pourraient réagir, sur la base des reportages de NBC News, NPR, UPI et de l'analyse du Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS).

segments.src: ## Why this speech matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ce discours est important

segments.src: Rodríguez's appearance carried symbolic weight before she said a word.
segments.tr: L'apparition de Rodríguez revêtait une importance symbolique avant même qu'elle ne prononce un mot.

segments.src: Reports describe it as the first visit to the United States by a Venezuelan head of state since 2018, when Maduro himself traveled to New York for the General Assembly.
segments.tr: Les rapports le décrivent comme la première visite aux États-Unis d'un chef d'État vénézuélien depuis 2018, date à laquelle Maduro lui-même s'était rendu à New York pour l'Assemblée générale.

segments.src: She took over after a surprise U.S.
segments.tr: Elle a pris le pouvoir après une opération militaire américaine surprise en janvier qui a capturé Maduro et l'a amené aux États-Unis pour faire face à des accusations de trafic de drogue.

segments.src: military operation in January that captured Maduro and brought him to the United States to face drug trafficking charges.
Since then, her government and Washington have moved from confrontation toward a working, if uneasy, relationship.
segments.tr: Depuis lors, son gouvernement et Washington sont passés de la confrontation à une relation de travail, bien que délicate.

segments.src: Standing at the UN lectern, Rodríguez was presenting Venezuela's new chapter to the world for the first time.
segments.tr: Debout à la tribune de l'ONU, Rodríguez présentait pour la première fois le nouveau chapitre du Venezuela au monde.

segments.src: ## What she said
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'elle a dit

segments.src: According to news reports, the main points of the address were:
segments.tr: Selon les reportages, les points principaux de l'allocution étaient :

segments.src: - **A pledge of elections.** "Elections will be held in Venezuela," she said, adding that the Venezuelan people will determine the "right moment" to move the process forward.
segments.tr: - **Un engagement électoral.** "Des élections auront lieu au Venezuela", a-t-elle déclaré, ajoutant que le peuple vénézuélien déterminerait le "moment opportun" pour faire avancer le processus.

segments.src: - **A dialogue with the opposition.** She said her government has begun a "political dialogue with opposition sectors" aimed at a process "based on equal conditions for all."
segments.tr: - **Un dialogue avec l'opposition.** Elle a indiqué que son gouvernement avait entamé un "dialogue politique avec les secteurs de l'opposition" visant un processus "fondé sur des conditions égales pour tous."

segments.src: - **Institutional readiness.** When a vote does take place, she said, the country's institutions "will be prepared to guarantee an inclusive and transparent process."
segments.tr: - **Préparation institutionnelle.** Lorsqu'un vote aura lieu, a-t-elle affirmé, les institutions du pays "seront préparées à garantir un processus inclusif et transparent."

segments.src: - **A definition of democracy.** "Democracy is not measured by the mere existence of elections," she argued. It is measured, in her words, by the quality of the competition that comes before them.
segments.tr: - **Une définition de la démocratie.** "La démocratie ne se mesure pas à la seule existence d'élections", a-t-elle soutenu. Elle se mesure, selon ses mots, à la qualité de la compétition qui les précède.

segments.src: - **A message of renewal.** "Today, Venezuela is being reborn," she said, while cautioning, "I do not promise you an easy way forward." She described rebuilding the country's "national soul" as a priority.
segments.tr: - **Un message de renouveau.** "Aujourd'hui, le Venezuela renaît", a-t-elle déclaré, tout en prévenant : "Je ne vous promets pas un chemin facile." Elle a décrit la reconstruction de "l'âme nationale" du pays comme une priorité.

segments.src: - **Thanks to Washington.** She thanked President Donald Trump and his administration for their willingness to restore diplomatic ties and described a recent meeting as "historic." She named energy, economic cooperation, security and the fight against transnational crime as areas of shared interest, and called a recent oil agreement one of the largest ever reached between the two countries.
segments.tr: - **Remerciements à Washington.** Elle a remercié le président Donald Trump et son administration pour leur volonté de rétablir les liens diplomatiques et a qualifié une récente réunion d'

segments.src: ## What she left out
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'elle a omis

segments.src: Several observers noted the gaps as much as the promises.
segments.tr: Plusieurs observateurs ont noté les lacunes autant que les promesses.

segments.src: - **No date.** The most important detail for any election, the calendar, was absent. She offered no timeline and no benchmarks for setting one.
segments.tr: - **Pas de date.** Le détail le plus important pour toute élection, le calendrier, était absent. Elle n'a offert aucun calendrier ni aucun point de repère pour en fixer un.

segments.src: - **No named negotiating partners.** She referred to "opposition sectors" without identifying which groups are at the table.
segments.tr: - **Aucun partenaire de négociation nommé.** Elle a fait référence à des "secteurs de l'opposition" sans identifier quels groupes sont à la table.

segments.src: - **No detail on judicial or electoral reform.** Independent analysts point out that credible elections usually depend on an updated voter roll and a restructured electoral authority. CSIS reports that no restructuring of the National Electoral Council has been discussed, and that voter rolls remain outdated.
segments.tr: - **Aucun détail sur la réforme judiciaire ou électorale.** Des analystes indépendants soulignent que des élections crédibles dépendent généralement d'une liste électorale mise à jour et d'une autorité électorale restructurée. Le CSIS rapporte qu'aucune restructuration du Conseil national électoral n'a été discutée et que les listes électorales restent obsolètes.

segments.src: - **No direct response to the UN's own findings.** A UN fact-finding mission recently reported that Venezuela's repressive apparatus "remains entirely intact," and that rights violations continue despite improvements. Rodríguez's speech did not directly address that assessment.
segments.tr: - **Pas de réponse directe aux conclusions de l'ONU.** Une mission d'établissement des faits de l'ONU a récemment rapporté que l'appareil répressif du Venezuela "reste entièrement intact" et que les violations des droits de l'homme se poursuivent malgré les améliorations. Le discours de Rodríguez n'a pas abordé directement cette évaluation.

segments.src: - **No mention of Maduro by name,** according to NBC News, a notable omission given that his capture is what brought her to office.
segments.tr: - **Aucune mention de Maduro par son nom**, selon NBC News, une omission notable étant donné que sa capture est ce qui l'a amenée au pouvoir.

segments.src: ## The domestic picture
segments.tr: ## Le panorama intérieur

segments.src: The speech landed in a country still under strain.
segments.tr: Le discours est intervenu dans un pays toujours sous tension.

segments.src: In its assessment, the first stage is largely complete, the second is underway but uneven, and the third, political transition, has stalled.
